plan-review.yaml declares Pass-1 rung 0 as trivial (haiku) but archaeology shows Pass-1 generated findings on opus for 115 verified runs until 2026-06-27, then zero ever since—a total regression the day _verifier_cfg downgraded the run cfg
the Pass-1 finder (which generates blocking findings) silently moved from opus to haiku post-b690, weakening the claim gate with no visible alarm or test detection

Pass-1's context-limit escalation ladder is size-based, not quality-based; plans fitting haiku's 200k window never escalate, and execution_mode=agentic code-grounding loses capability moving from sonnet to haiku
prerequisite finder bin-packing now sizes against haiku's 200k instead of opus's 1M, causing escalation to fire where it previously could not and burning tokens on unnecessary attempts

the fix is to restore plan-review.yaml model_ladder rung 0 to frontier (opus) so Pass-1 generates findings as intended, while Pass-2 verify and Pass-4 coach remain on standard (sonnet) per _verifier_cfg
